notes.title: ENDLESS MODE UPDATE! And Future plans
notes.content:
[u]FUTURE PLANS[/u]
I have enjoyed creating KOUR 64, and I could add things forever, but for now I am going to halt adding anything new, the game feels complete. I will likely add more in the future, but I am going to focus my efforts on a new project now. Thank everyone for playing, streaming, giving feedback and leaving reviews! It has all helped the game become much better and I welcome more of it! Let me know how your experience was in the discord or by leaving a review!

This update brings 4 new levels to endless mode, a new compass for endless mode to help find the next objective quicker, An update to the golden golf power, new ambient noises for multiple levels, along with a bunch of other small fixes. 

PATCH NOTES
-added 4 levels to endless
-added saving to endless

-Rising Lava display Updated to show new star icon

-Added ambient noises for timer levels

-Adjusted some obstacles on Temple Slide to make it more fair
-Fixed Bug on Fishin that would cause the Fish Coins not to spawn
-Golden Golf Power can now be activated by an input
-Golden Golf Power approximately 6x easier to get
-Music for City

notes.title: Graeldon Update 9/17/24
notes.content:
Hey everyone, recently I had the pleasure of watching the YouTuber Graeldon play through KOUR 64 live on stream. He's reviewing all steam games in alphabetical order, but he was kind enough to check out my project early, stream it and give his feedback. This update is a result of that. Lots of quality of life changes and fixes. You can check out the livestream VOD here.
https://www.youtube.com/live/dDq5Cv22nEM?si=CYSI4Rji_nV5oZmH

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
-Fixed a few spots in Hub where you could climb outside of the map
-Golf Flags now have a bottom green part for easier identification
-Slight changes to intro to guide the player better
-Bouncy power tutorial updated to better explain how it works
-Bouncy power Icon fixed so it correctly displays when you will bounce
-Starting platform on the first lava level is now larger
-fixed wrong textures on pipes in lava 1
-Added animation to End Door
-Fixed physics on slide levels so they are consistent on any Framerate
-Moved objectives and changed slide speeds on the Slide levels to make the levels more fair
-Added Out of Bounds Reset in Hub
-SteamVR is now disabled, so it shouldnt show up in the launch options if you have VR 
-Updated Fruit & Fish minigame signs
-Added a button to skip dialogue
-Fixed an issue where really low resolutions couldn't exit the settings menu
-Textboxes are now larger
-"Grael was here" secret added to Hub OOB
-Fixed a bug where saves would get overwritten by endless mode

[b]FUTURE PLANS[/b]
-Add rest of levels for endless mode + a 3d compass that points towards the next point. And possibly some extra gameplay modifiers such as temporary powerups that spawn.
-Add saving to endless mode, right now scores reset if you exit the game or change saves
-Expand the soundtrack + more ambient noises
-Add more secrets and side content that doesn't count towards completion, just fun stuff to find and do
-Achievements

notes.title: Endless Mode Introduction Update 9/13/24
notes.content:
A New Endless Game Mode to test your movement abilities! Currently there is one level for this mode, a new small playground where the mode was developed. I plan on turning all suitable levels from the main story into maps for this, and I also have another unique level for it on the way too! 

Otherwise, there have been some small tweaks and fixes. New art pieces and level details. And new NPC dialogue and voice lines. And some new sounds added too. 

Added discord link to main menu. Join the community and let me know your suggestions! 
Thank you for playing and leaving reviews! Your feedback helps!
